exposure: in utero serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SRI) antidepressant exposure
cohort: A total of 214 mothers and their infants from two observational studies, categorized into three groups based on maternal psychotropic exposure and mood disorder status during pregnancy: comparison, SRI-exposed, and mood disorder.
finding: The presence of neonatal signs at 2-4 weeks after birth was more closely associated with prematurity than with in utero SRI or maternal mood disorder exposure.
